## 9c5bdbcdcd50

**A1 — No functional issue found within the checked documented profiles.** Generator SHA-256 `eb0643056f354373afe38e6004c748ce8be2fe42091bf8fed20ce81746b44596`; canonical rule `c2cf9830b316`; exact executed rule text SHA-256 `c8c84f9144b9493628aa4d467ddf09322c33470b9c3700e63d68bca67fe28079`.

Checked all eight declared scene profiles in all three bands at seeds 0 and 1, index 0 (48 draws), plus defaults for seeds 0–4, index 1, in each band (15 draws). All 63 inputs passed the target validator; there were 42 unique grids. A separate background-component flood-fill oracle—not the module's `rule_mirror`—matched actual canonical Racket outputs on all 63/63. It correctly fills top-left/top-right/bottom-left/bottom-right regions 2/4/1/8, strict interior 7, other edges 0, preserving 3-dividers. No general or exhaustive theorem about other profiles is claimed.

Domain/curriculum caution: explicitly selecting a `public_*` profile returns its frozen official anchor, so those override draws are not independently diverse. This is documented anchor behavior, not evidence that the default sampler is frozen. The unique-grid denominator above includes these duplicates. The module opening says colors are 2,4,1,8 “clockwise”; that wording should be “in reading order.” The invariant, code, and measured labels agree, so this is an editorial issue only.

Reproducers: `checks/audit/probe_audits.py`, `checks/audit/9c5bdbcdcd50/probe.json`, `input.json`, `racket.json`, and `comparison.json`. Exact supported apply command and exit 0 are recorded in RESULTS. Source and authority left unchanged.
